gold_row.question: Welche Temperatur hat Sensor 6.0 am 2004-03-01 um 03:00:16 gemessen?
gold_row.gold_answer: Dazu liegen mir keine Daten vor.
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 6})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-03-01T03:00:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.temperature AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
